name: Hover Effects Addons for Elementor
author: pixelonetry

sections.description:
Hover Effects Addon for Elementor Page Builder is the best customized hover effects for your image.

Add title and description to your image.

Note: This plugin requires Elementor Website Builder.

Get Pro

Features

  • Clean CSS3 Effects
  • Fully Responsive
  • 10 Hover Effects
  • Image Uploads
  • Fast performance
  • Easy to Use
  • Both transition support left_to_right, right_to_left, top_to_bottom and bottom_to_top.

PRO Features

  • Hower Effects with Icons
  • 20 Premium Hover Effects
  • 100% Responsive
  • Custom Font Sizes
  • Custom Font Family
  • Custom Caption Colors
  • Heading Background Colors
  • Caption Background Colour
  • Caption Background Image
  • Custom Border Width
  • Heading and Description Color
  • Custom Border Color
  • Title Over Image

Customizations

Hover Effects for Elementor with CSS3 styles that add stunning.

SEO Friendly

All the Images is SEO Optimized with Alt Image Alt Tag.
Link your image to a specified URL.

Where it can be used

On All The WordPress websites that supports Elementor!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it (alternatively, install through the WP admin console)
  2. Edit any page/post using edit with elementor option
  3. On elementor widget menu, search/scroll and find the Hover effects addons
  4. Drag and drop this addon, where you have to add the section
  5. Customize the options and add the content
  6. Hurray! in a minute you have added the Image Hover Section
sections.faq:
Can I upgrade this to pro version?

Yes, but you need to remove or deactivate the free plugin after version
